source_state: Uncommitted implementation identified by hashes below; the release archive independently pins committed source.

scope: Explicit baseline invalidation on start and stop
Reject cached pre-start and duplicate timestamps
Stop and resume without reusing old samples
Refuse unavailable, silent, and invalid sensor data

checks.scope: All current Swift app sources typecheck for iOS 17 using the installed iOS 26.5 SDK; native runtime verification is retained separately.

platform_contract.payload: Raw Core Motion CMQuaternion [x,y,z,w], with no camera conversion in Swift.
platform_contract.reference_frame: xArbitraryZVertical; no magnetic or true-north dependency.
platform_contract.time: Hardware timestamp is seconds since boot. Adapter start and poll use CACurrentMediaTime; CADisplayLink.timestamp is reserved for Rust frame timing.
platform_contract.lifecycle: Every decoded Rust packet drives sensor interest before UI publication throttling. Native inactivity and detach stop acquisition immediately.
platform_contract.failure: Unavailable, invalid, or absent sensor updates return to touch mode with a notice. Unrelated retained world errors are not classified as sensor failures.
platform_contract.fixture: --synthetic --motion-preview is required. The fixture has an upright raw portrait quaternion and does not claim physical sensor availability.

limits: No physical iPhone direction, drift, latency, permission, battery, or thermal validation.
Physical orientation conversion is implemented and tested in Rust; these native checks cover lifetime and bounded pass-through.
No network, model, benchmark, or real Gym execution.
